spec_match.rationale: Every step targets the real shipped surface: the exact --enable-features=SuspiciousSiteWarnings switch (verified against features.cc; no chrome://flags entry and not a Blink runtime feature), chrome://settings/security enrollment, the chrome://safe-browsing real-time lookup panel, and the SafeBrowsing.SuspiciousSiteWarning.VerdictReceived histogram from url_realtime_mechanism.cc.

interactive.rationale: Five-step tracker with per-step done state, visual completion marking, persisted progress, live progress announcements, and copy buttons for every launch point with honest per-button status.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises a guided real-Chrome workflow with the exact switch, internals, and histograms; the page delivers those five steps.

edge_cases.rationale: States the honest limitation up front: no public URL is guaranteed to return a WARN verdict, so testsafebrowsing.appspot.com is framed strictly as the confirmed-threat contrast, not a pop-up trigger; clipboard denial/timeout paths degrade with explicit instructions.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry plus the two Chromium source files (histogram site, base::Feature definition) that the steps depend on.

conformance.rationale: This lab is the designated manual-verification path referenced by the suite's blocked assertions (enhanced-warn-verdict-shows-popup, gated-on-suspicioussitewarnings-feature), keeping the manual contracts actionable rather than dead text.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP harness verified step toggling, visual done-state, persisted progress, and the copy path reporting an honest blocked status (TimeoutError) in the headless environment rather than fake success; zero console errors; both class screenshots captured.

telemetry_health.rationale: ssw-fieldlab-progress-persisted asserts storage writes; ssw-copy-launch-point asserts per-copy success AND explicitly asserts the failure branch as false with the error name, per the fallback-assertion rule.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; step numbers are bg-ivory on text-black; done steps get an emerald border accent; copy status text is charcoal on paper (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Steps are labelled checkboxes with for/id pairing, progress and summary in polite live regions, per-copy-button live status, decorative step numbers aria-hidden, visible focus everywhere.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at both classes (long chrome:// strings wrap via overflow-wrap:anywhere); copy buttons go full-width on narrow viewports; both screenshots legible.

openQuestions.title: Track whether Google publishes a WARN-verdict test URL
openQuestions.detail: testsafebrowsing.appspot.com only exercises confirmed-threat interstitials. If Google ever publishes a page that reliably returns SOCIAL_ENGINEERING + WARN (the way it does for confirmed threats), add it to step 4 so the pop-up itself becomes directly reproducible.

openQuestions.title: Re-check the base::Feature default state at Chrome 152 stable cut
openQuestions.detail: features.cc at main still says FEATURE_DISABLED_BY_DEFAULT with the launch riding a rollout. Once 152 is stable, confirm whether the switch is still needed for step 1 or the default flipped, and update the step copy accordingly.

guidanceConsulted.query: copy to clipboard button with accessible status feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Tie button actions to immediate, perceivable, per-control feedback.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every copy button has its own adjacent aria-live status span; writeText is raced with a 1.5s timeout so a hung permission prompt yields an honest 'Copy blocked (TimeoutError)' with a manual fallback instruction instead of silence.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive-ssw.mjs: 'fieldlab: copy button reports honest status' PASS with observed blocked status in headless.

guidanceConsulted.query: step by step task tracker checkbox progress accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native checkboxes for completion state and announce aggregate progress via a live region rather than colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Done state is a native labelled checkbox per step; the emerald border is reinforced by the announced 'N of 5 steps done' output and a completion summary line.

summary: Advanced concept: the only honest way to see this feature is a real Chrome, so the lab turns that into a five-step guided workflow (switch, enrollment, internals stream, interstitial contrast, histogram) with persisted progress and timeout-guarded copy launch points. Harness-verified interactions and honest clipboard degradation; parity clean at both classes.
